title: Asteya
one_line: Not stealing the property or possessions of others.
points: Asteya means not stealing the property or possessions of others.
Guruji writes that being envious of or begrudging another, cheating someone with sweet words, and gaining selfish ends under the guise of truthfulness are all to be abandoned.
Heaps of gems fall before the yogi who practices asteya, and he becomes the abode of all gems.

sutra.translation: Upon being established in non-stealing, there occurs the attainment of all prosperity.
